scope: Presidential Decree No. 1429, 1959-01-13: SNU public-administration/public-health institutional creation and actor attribution

actors.name: 이승만
actions: The formal legal instrument was Presidential Decree No. 1429, promulgated 1959-01-13 and effective 1959-04-01. Article 3 expressly created both the Graduate School of Public Administration and Graduate School of Public Health at Seoul National University.
actors.attribution_limits: The decree establishes formal presidential legal action, not policy authorship, drafting, or the originating institutional proposal. Those remain open pending cabinet and Ministry proposal records.
open_leads: recover original promulgation/signature image for Presidential Decree No. 1429
recover Ministry of Education proposal sheet and SNU correspondence

actors.name: 최재유
actions: Served as Minister of Education during promulgation and implementation of Decree No. 1429; the decree placed national schools under the Minister of Education's jurisdiction.
actors.attribution_limits: Portfolio responsibility is strong institutional linkage, but proposer/drafter/signatory status for Decree No. 1429 is not assigned without the proposal and signature originals.
open_leads: cabinet proposal sheet for Decree No. 1429
Ministry bureau responsible for national-university organization

actors.name: 명주완
actions: Institutional histories identify him with the opening of SNU public-health graduate education in 1959 and as the first dean/director of the Graduate School of Public Health.
actors.attribution_limits: This pass does not yet prove that he drafted or formally proposed the Decree No. 1429 amendment.
open_leads: recover SNU Graduate School of Public Health 50-year history pages on founding negotiations
verify exact first-dean appointment date and instrument

actors.name: 1959 서울대 행정대학원 초대 책임자
actors.attribution_limits: Official GSPA history verifies the institution and legal basis but the current pass did not recover a primary appointment instrument identifying the first dean/responsible administrator.
open_leads: trace College of Law-to-GSPA transitional administration
